description:
Hindi Diwas Celebration – 14th September 2026

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown celebrated Hindi Diwas on 14th September 2026 in a unique and engaging online initiative.

The programme was organised by the Rotaractors, who brought together members and Rotractors from other Clubs, joining and participating online. The celebration highlighted the richness, importance and cultural significance of the Hindi language, while creating an opportunity for fellowship and interaction overall.

The initiative was well received, with enthusiastic participation making it a meaningful celebration of our language and heritage.

Hindi • Heritage • Fellowship • Togetherness
